summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani dismissed the business and civic leaders who advised a multimillion-dollar fund that channels private donations into public programs, removing a longstanding group of corporate advisers from City Hall’s philanthropic arm.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google to Join White House AI Safety Meeting
title_cn: OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌将参加白宫人工智能安全会议
summary: The Trump administration plans to host artificial intelligence companies at the White House on Tuesday to discuss a new US framework for conducting voluntary safety tests of AI models, according to people familiar with the matter.
